method: Each regression injected alone into the file named, the named test file run with node --test, the file restored. Each failed exactly the one test listed and no other.

injections.regression: the kept ground is reused for a new snapshot (sameLayerKey ignores the world object)
failed: the kept ground is laid down again only for the same snapshot, camera and canvas

injections.regression: setText writes the node every time
failed: a node is written only when its words change, so the drawing loop does not touch the page twelve times a second

injections.regression: segmentsNear ignores the reach, dropping a creek just outside the view
failed: a course is measured against only its segments near the view, and every distance in the view is unchanged

injections.regression: visibleSegments ignores how far a curve bulges from its two points
failed: a river laid down only where it can reach the screen is the same curve there

injections.regression: water held at the old figure floor (eighteen pixels for a river at any wide zoom)
failed: water narrows steadily as the camera pulls back and never swells into a lake at a wide zoom

injections.regression: the trees switch on at one zoom (band 0.41 to 0.4 square miles)
failed: the woods hand over between trees, canopy and shade across bands of zoom, never at one wheel step

injections.regression: the scatter draws only its finest level, re-rolling the ground at every band
failed: the scattered ground stays where it is as the camera comes in, and only fades in or out

injections.regression: the cover blurred without premultiplied alpha
failed: a grid of cover is smoothed into soft edges without bleeding grey into the empty cells

injections.regression: the prairie's rocks threshold moved from .095 to .12
failed: a class of ground is a table entry, and the prairie draws the marks the map always drew

injections.regression: the prairie's rocks lose their drawn fallback shape
failed: the renderer treats every sprite as optional

injections.regression: the canvas drawn at the full screen density with no pixel budget
failed: the map is drawn sharp on a dense screen but never at more pixels than a 1080p frame
